title: Ampelite Australia Pty Ltd - FGW Corporation Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced informal review under the Informal Merger Review Process Guidelines.
ACCC discontinued its public review after Ampelite and FGW withdrew their application for informal merger clearance.

body_sections.Summary: Ampelite Australia Pty Ltd (Ampelite) proposes to merge with FGW Corporation Pty Ltd (FGW), by creating a new entity to acquire and operate the Ampelite WA business and the FGW business. The parties overlap in the supply of fibreglass and polycarbonate roof sheeting products in Western Australia.
